up: Join activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, and molecule_dictionary. Filter activities for standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3526'. Return columns: assays.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, assays.assay_tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value. Order by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id and assays.chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, assays.assay_tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3526' AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
